name: Lightkeeper Temple
desc:
**Lightkeeper Temple** is a now abandoned temple that was once home to Lightkeepers. Once known as the [Temple of Mur](location:temple_of_mur).

The temple's entrance is along the route taken to the [Widow's Hollow](location:widows_hollow). One of the jail cells inside of the temple leads to the [Deep Thresher Nest](location:deep_thresher_nest).
additional_info:
-   Before completely changing into the [Temple of Mur](location:temple_of_mur), the Lightkeeper Temple was a much larger set of rooms and hallways littered with Threshers and King Threshers.

-   The player was able to wash their face from the fountain inside of the room with the obelisk, allowing access to [The Lordsgrove](location:the_lordsgrove) and the ability to use the Fountain Gates anywhere within Lumen.
    -   An abundance of extra rooms and Thresher Eggs was present throughout the temple, with even a large prison located in the bottom.

-   During early testing, this area was called "Stormcaller Temple," with its caption being "???"
-   The area originally came with the caption "Heavy is the burden of the Lightkeeper, for the whole world rests on their shoulders". It was removed in a shadow update.
